referenceFunction.generalComment: The storage and pumped storage hydropower are sharing the same infrastructure, consequently the impacts of the reservoirs, the area used, the amount of turbined water and the greenhouse gas emissions are shared with the storage hydropower. The lifetime is assumed to be 150 years for the dams and 80 years for the other material. The data describe a mix and can therefore not be used for an individual pumped storage hydropower station. This dataset is recalculated based on Frischknecht et al. (1996) and Bauer (2007), complemented with data from Vattenfall (2008) and Diem et al. (2008). Electricity consumption has been updated based on EIA (2025) data for 2021-2023. This dataset represents an update of the local dataset originally published in Flury K., Frischknecht R. (2011), which is only adjusted in the electricity input requirements. Additionally, the electricity production mix input has been replaced with the corresponding supply mix to reflect that also imported electricity can be used for the pumping; UUID: 93b8722f-2499-3935-8b5c-018075472b61
referenceFunction.includedProcesses: Operation of an average storage hydropower station. It includes the electricity consumption, the area transformed and occupied, the volume of the reservoir, greenhouse gas emissions, the consumption of lubricant oil and the amount of turbined water.
